When does New Year 2027 start in Brazil?

Brazil spans 4 different UTC offsets on New Year's Eve, so 2027 arrives in waves. The first region to celebrate is Fernando de Noronha (UTC-02:00) at 02:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027, and the last is Rio Branco (UTC-05:00), 3 hours later.

The countdown above follows São Paulo, where midnight falls at 03:00 UTC.

New Year's Day 2027 falls on a Friday.

Brazil in the global New Year countdown

The first places on Earth to enter 2027 are the Line Islands of Kiribati (UTC+14:00). São Paulo follows 17 hours later, and the last inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC-11:00), celebrate 8 hours after São Paulo.

When the clock strikes midnight in São Paulo, 161 of the 196 countries in our world time zone table already have at least one region celebrating 2027.

  • Just before (UTC-01:00): Portugal (Azores) and Cape Verde
  • Just after (UTC-03:30): Canada (St. John's)

Who celebrates at the same time as Brazil?

These countries also reach midnight at UTC-03:00, so they welcome 2027 at exactly the same moment as São Paulo: Argentina, Chile (Santiago), Paraguay, Uruguay and Suriname.

New Year traditions in Brazil

Brazilians traditionally dress in white for Réveillon. On Copacabana beach in Rio de Janeiro, millions gather for the fireworks, and many people jump seven waves or offer flowers to Iemanjá, the goddess of the sea.

Frequently asked questions

What time is New Year 2027 in Brazil in UTC?

Midnight in São Paulo corresponds to 03:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027. Other regions of Brazil follow, up to 3 hours apart.

How many time zones does Brazil have on New Year's Eve?

Brazil uses 4 different UTC offsets on December 31, from UTC-02:00 in Fernando de Noronha to UTC-05:00 in Rio Branco.

Is daylight saving time in effect in Brazil on New Year's Eve?

No. São Paulo keeps UTC-03:00 all year round.

Which countries celebrate New Year just before Brazil?

The previous time zone to reach midnight is UTC-01:00, which includes Portugal (Azores) and Cape Verde.
